seo.title: Sell your car — carsens
seo.description: List your car on carsens for free: pick your model, add photos, and go live after a quick review.

title: Sell your car. Free. Fast.
subtitle: A few quick steps — most specs fill themselves in.

restore.title: Welcome back
restore.body: You have an unfinished listing saved {{time}}.

draftLocked: Your draft is created — vehicle and price details are locked from here. Continue with photos.

vehicle.title: Tell us about your car
vehicle.subtitle: Pick make, model and trim — chances are we already know its full spec sheet.
vehicle.loadError: Could not load vehicle data. Please try again.

autofill.loading: Looking up your car's spec sheet…
autofill.title: Specs auto-filled from our database
autofill.subtitle: These details attach to your ad automatically — nothing to type.
autofill.notFoundBody: We don't have a spec sheet for this configuration yet. You can still continue and fill in the details yourself.

specs.title: Specs & price
specs.subtitle: The details buyers always ask about.
specs.vinHint: 17 characters — helps serious buyers trust your ad.
specs.descriptionHint: Condition, service history, extras — at least {{min}} characters.

photos.title: Add photos
photos.subtitle: At least {{min}} photos — the first one becomes your cover.
photos.formats: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to {{max}} photos
photos.maxReached: You can add up to {{max}} photos.
photos.typeRejected: Some files were skipped — only JPEG, PNG and WebP images are supported.
photos.gate: Add at least {{min}} photos to continue.
photos.waitUploads: Wait for uploads to finish before continuing.

review.title: Review your ad
review.subtitle: One last look before it goes to our moderation team.

errors.quota: You have reached your listing limit. Manage your existing listings from your account.
errors.vinDuplicate: An active listing with this VIN already exists.
errors.minPhotos: Your ad needs at least {{min}} photos before it can be submitted.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.mileageInvalid: Enter the mileage as a whole number of kilometres.
validation.priceInvalid: Enter the price as a whole number in AED.
validation.vinInvalid: A VIN is 17 letters and digits (no I, O or Q).
validation.descriptionMin: The description needs at least {{min}} characters.
validation.descriptionMax: The description can have at most {{max}} characters.

done.title: Your car is on its way 🎉
done.body: Our team reviews every ad within 24 hours. You'll get an email as soon as it goes live.
